company.name: Asimov
company.shortDescription: Asimov employs artificial intelligence to develop tools for the design and manufacture of next-generation therapeutics.
company.description:
Asimov creates tools for programming living cells. Its multidisciplinary team is advancing the design and manufacture of biologics and gene therapies by integrating mammalian synthetic biology, computer-aided design, and machine learning.

Asimov was established in 2017 by Raja Srinivas in Boston, Massachusetts.

productsAndServices.description: A CHO-based biologics expression system combining engineered host cells, genetic parts, AI-assisted vector design, and cell-line development to produce therapeutic proteins at high titers.
productsAndServices.name: CHO Edge System

productsAndServices.description: A modular platform for AAV gene-therapy payload design and production, combining computational design tools, genetic parts, HEK293 host cells, plasmid systems, and stable or transient manufacturing workflows.
productsAndServices.name: AAV Edge System

productsAndServices.description: Cloud-based computer-aided design software for designing, simulating, analyzing, and optimizing genetic systems, expression vectors, and therapeutic payloads.
productsAndServices.name: Kernel

productsAndServices.description: A lab-in-the-loop platform that uses AI-guided sequence design, genetic parts, RNA production, and cell-based screening to optimize linear or circular RNA therapeutic candidates.
productsAndServices.name: RNA Edge System

productsAndServices.description: A lentiviral-vector production platform using engineered stable cell lines, packaging genetic tools, and software-assisted design to improve lentiviral titers and manufacturing consistency.
productsAndServices.name: LV Edge System

productsAndServices.description: Contract development services for designing, generating, screening, and characterizing stable producer cell lines and transferring optimized processes for biologics and viral-vector programs.
productsAndServices.name: Cell Line Development and Process Development Services

insights.title: Hybrid therapeutic platform
insights.statement: Asimov combines AAV Edge System with CHO Edge System.
insights.implication: The company is positioned as a biotechnology platform with both a physical therapeutic-delivery modality and an AI-assisted discovery layer, rather than as a standalone AI software vendor.
caveats: Product descriptions are profile claims and do not establish clinical efficacy.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series B round raised $175,000,000, or 85.37% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $8,552,985 to $851,556,099, a 99.56x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 49 (-4 over 90 days) and market heat at 78 (+3).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
